title: Software Engineer, Brazil - X Delivery
description: Software Engineer, Brazil - X Delivery – BCG X Software Engineer, Brazil - X Delivery – BCG X Locations: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation‑inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom‑line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading‑edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. We Are BCG X We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game‑changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions. What You’ll Do As a part of BCG’s X Delivery team, you will play a pivotal role in bridging technology and strategy. You will collaborate with premier consulting teams around the world, applying your software development expertise across a variety of ambitious and ground‑breaking international projects. You will be instrumental in advancing BCG’s Consulting and BCG X teams by providing critical software development insights and speeding up project execution. As a Software Engineer, your role involves close collaboration with consulting teams to address complex and diverse technological challenges. You will apply your expertise in software development methodologies to add value to BCG’s Consulting & BCG X teams and Practice Areas. Each project offers a unique opportunity to showcase your skills and make a significant impact within BCG and our esteemed clientele. What You’ll Bring We are seeking technologically adept engineers who bring strong experience and diverse skills to our dynamic team. This role is an outstanding opportunity for someone who is passionate about software development and embraces opportunities to learn and make an impact in a fast‑paced, innovative environment. If you’re driven by technology and ready for impactful challenges, our BCG X Delivery team could be a great match! Technical Skills – Knowledge and Experience With Coding Skills: Strong coding skills and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Rust, C#, etc. Experience with multiple languages preferred. Web Development Expertise: Experience with Typescript or JavaScript frameworks such as React, Next.js, and Angular. Demonstrated projects or work experience are helpful. API Development: Solid experience in creating APIs using REST or GraphQL. Cloud Computing: Familiar with AWS, Azure, GCP, and capable of effective deployment on these platforms. Database Management: Skilled in both relational and NoSQL databases, including MongoDB, Neo4j, and Redis. Additional Skills Experience with Spark, Hadoop, or similar systems. Practical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, or similar technologies. Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI, Jenkins, etc. Tech curiosity with interest and exposure to technologies like AR/VR, IoT, AI, Blockchain. Knowledge of infrastructure as code practices using Terraform, Chef, Puppet, or Ansible. Job Requirements Bachelor’s / Master’s in Computer Science or a related field Fluency in Portuguese and English Proven background in end‑to‑end application development, preferably in a commercial or consulting environment. Active contributions to open‑source projects or technical communities are highly valued. Core Attributes Software Development: Demonstrated experience in developing, testing, and deploying robust software. Examples of past projects or contributions are advantageous. Full Lifecycle Experience: Active involvement in the complete software development lifecycle, showcasing skills from idea generation to deployment. Efficiency Optimization: Experience in optimizing software for performance and efficiency. Dynamic Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, client‑facing environment. Experience in client interactions for product development is a plus. Collaborative Skills: A track record of working effectively in team settings, sharing ideas, and co‑developing solutions. Additional Information Please apply for the positions equivalent to your previous work experiences. The seniority will be evaluated according to your experience and career structure at BCG X during the process. Even if you don’t meet all these requirements, we encourage you to apply if this job description excites you. Note: For this position, we are considering applicants from São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, including both the capital cities and the surrounding areas within a 150km radius of the capitals. Equal Opportunity Employer Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws. title: Professor(a) de História (History) - Fundamental 2 - Barra da Tijuca/RJ
description: Professor(a) de História (History) - Fundamental 2 - Barra da Tijuca/RJ O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo. SOBRE A VAGA A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo. Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de História (History) - Fundamental 2. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina. RESPONSABILIDADES O que você fará: Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona; Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência; Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos; Ministrar aulas de História (History) alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital); Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos; Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado; Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares; Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado; Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola; Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados; Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado; Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias; Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola; Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding). Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo. REQUISITOS O que você precisa ter: Diploma de Licenciatura em História; Experiência com Fundamental 2; Inglês fluente para ministrar aulas nesse idioma. Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter: Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe; Paixão pela profissão; Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks; Estar sempre em busca de melhorias; Atitude positiva frente a mudanças; Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada; Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas; Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala; Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado; Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho; Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais; Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time; Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Founded in 1867, and located in Washington, DC, in our nation’s capital, Howard University is a historically Black College/University and Research 1 (R1) institution with a distinguished legacy of advancing knowledge, leadership, and service in pursuit of social justice and equity. Serving 400 students, the Howard University School of Social Work offers two MSW concentrations: Direct Practice and Community, Administration, and Policy Practice. These concentrations are delivered through two program platforms, on-campus (Flagship) and online (Starship). The School offers specializations in criminal justice, health, mental health, family and child welfare, displaced populations, and social gerontology. We also offer three dual degree programs: MSW/MPH, MSW/MDiv, and MSW/MBA. Additionally, the School offers a Ph.D. in Social Work with specialized areas of scholarly inquiry. Grounded in the University’s enduring motto, Truth and Service, the HUSSW prepares scholars and practitioners committed to improving human well-being and addressing the structural conditions that affect marginalized communities. The School’s guiding philosophy, Black Perspective, further shapes its intellectual and practice framework through our curriculum and faculty scholarship that examine social and economic injustice, social determinants of health, behavioral health, poverty, and disparities effecting quality of life, particularly for African Americans and other historically oppressed populations. Our School has been continuously accredited during its 90-year history. We are a highly ranked graduate/professional program at the university having been ranked by the U.S. News and World Report among the country’s top-20 MSW programs. With an abiding interest in both domestic and international affairs, the University is committed to continuing to produce leaders for America and the global community. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically. Perform ad-hoc analysis and prepare additional financial reports as requested by the Head of Finance and senior management. Strong attention to detail and a focus on quality and accuracy. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Excel, Power BI Word & PowerPoint presentation. Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast‑paced and high‑volume environment. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. title: Well Site Coordinator
description: The Well Site Supervisor is responsible to plan, coordinate, supervise, and execute the well operations program. Organize and lead brief and debrief safety and operations meetings that are related to well operations. Lead daily planning meetings and discuss operations with customer representatives, contractors, PL, and third-party supervisors. Update forecast and planned activity to anticipate resource requirements meet well demands and provide optimum service efficiency. Check that equipment and services comply with the contract. Ensure that operations are conducted to prevent risks of well control, stuck pipe, and any other project and operational risks. Monitor well operational risks, implement risk responses, and execute change control per the project risk management plan and well operational programs. Ensure compliance with Schlumberger policies and Integration PL standards, including standing orders. Prepare detailed procedures for specific critical operations (running casing, cementing, etc.) and associated contingency plans. Prepare daily cost estimates based on goods consumed and services provided. Review and approve invoices and reports on services performed and materials used. Manage and monitor operations communications with the goal of ensuring that stakeholders are kept informed and service providers are lacking any information that they need to perform their services. Prepare technical and operational calculations relevant to the well‑or rig‑site operations (e.g., cement volume). Participate in operational performance improvements and program changes with the project team. Review operational problems and support job incidents, changes, incident response and recovery, including coordination with the individual PLs and key contractors. description: Descrição da vaga ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. This role may provide guidance to team members and colleagues working within the Enterprise Technology Services department. This position involves managerial and supervisory responsibilities in areas of security, access, and Workday development and works in collaboration with cross‑functional teams, overseeing project‑specific tasks related to Workday implementations, and ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards. The Senior Workday Security Administrator is responsible for overseeing daily tasks, providing mentorship, and ensuring alignment with Howard University’s policies and objectives along with evaluating performance, ensuring the effective execution of security protocols and fostering a collaborative work environment that supports operational excellence. Nature And Scope Operating within a dynamic and fast‑paced environment, this role ensures that Workday security and Workday applications that support the user experience are designed to meet business needs and maintain compliance with regulatory and auditing requirements. Scalable solutions are designed to align with organizational goals and improve operational efficiency. Principal Accountabilities Security Configuration and Access Own and maintain a secure and scalable Workday security framework to include integrations, role‑based security, security groups, domain security policies, and business process security policies, user provisioning (authentication policy), and proxy policy to control user access and permissions. Conduct regular security reviews, access audits, and recommend improvements based on findings. Analyze and design Workday security to ensure users have the appropriate and necessary permissions to perform their job role and functions. Auditing and Compliance Comply with compliance and audit requirements by conducting regular security assessments and supporting audit readiness to ensure regulatory and privacy requirements are met. Provide guidance on segregation of duties (SoD) and least‑privilege access principles. Manage the monitoring controls set up to protect sensitive institutional and personal data in compliance with FERPA, HIPAA, and other applicable regulations. Maintain documentation related to system configurations and processes, documenting proper internal security controls. Development, Security, and Testing Collaborate stakeholders across HR, Finance, Student, and IT teams to understand business needs, to identify continuous improvement opportunities for streamlining processes and operations through Workday Illuminate AI and Agentic AI, Workday Extend and other IT developed configuration, and to translate them into scalable, secure solutions for a quality user experience. Oversee and lead in the full development lifecycle of Workday Extend applications and other IT developed configuration to support University priorities – from requirement gathering to architecture, design, development, testing, and deployment, and post‑implementation support. Ensure adherence to Workday best practices and maintain high performance and scalability of Extend apps and other IT developed configuration. Support functionality design, testing, and migration along with and as it relates to Workday development and security and create and update reports as operationally needed. Adoption and Support Serve as the primary liaison with Workday Security community forums to stay abreast of Workday releases and functionality, product updates, best practices, changing development capabilities, evolving security trends, and emerging issues relevant to higher education. Adhere to and align with best practices for Workday governance, release management, and change control in pursuit of institutional goals. Research and recommend enhancements to maximize the capabilities of the system. Develop and maintain a Workday roadmap for security and IT developed solutions that is aligned with business objectives and with respect to releases, reviewing release notes, and assessing and understanding the impacts on security in the tenants. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, responsibility, collaboration, communication, and continuous improvement. Participate in Change Control process with functional areas to review, approve and execute change requests related to Workday applications, IT developed configurations, and Workday Security. Minimum Requirements A bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent experience in fields related to business administration, information technology, computer science, or software development; including 5 or more years of experience in Higher Education with Workday security and development that includes Workday Extend; minimum of 3 years technical experience with Workday related to functionality of Finance, Human Capital Management, Adaptive, and Student modules. Familiarity with higher education processes and best practices. Experience in designing, configuring, testing, and supporting functional areas, including process documentation. Hands‑on experience with Workday Extend, all aspects of Workday Security, Business Processes, Workday Reporting and other core Workday functionality in a higher education environment. Workday certifications in Extend, Security, or Integration, Business Process and Report Writer preferred. Familiarity with JSON, REST APIs, and strong understanding of object‑oriented programming XML, XSLT, JSON, and API technologies and Workday Report Writer. Knowledge of ITIL, Agile, SDLC, DevOps, and CI/CD methodologies. Experience supporting multiple priorities and projects concurrently. Must be able to thrive in a demanding, change‑oriented, fast‑paced environment. Understanding project management and service life cycle concepts and practices. Proven experience collaborating with cross‑functional Workday teams. Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills. Background in SOX compliance, GDPR, or other data privacy regulations, preferred. Expected Salary Range $125,000 - $140,000 #J-18808-Ljbffr

KDM is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer - OCR with great problem-solving skills who is comfortable working with minimal supervision. This is an exciting opportunity to play an integral role in achieving the company’s goals. Qualified candidates will bring a strong knowledge of supervised image classification and open-source technologies to help us address our customer’s needs. Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., (occasional extended hours to support deployments or maintain service continuity) Full‑Time position The Company Katalyst Data Management (KDM) is the global leader in hosted subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification, to data storage and organisation, to marketing data online, our specialised data services cater to large multinational corporations, national governments and small independents. KDM’s web‑based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment has enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities. Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities Own the platform, elevate the velocity. The DevOps Engineer is at the center of designing and running our next‑gen hybrid infrastructure, orchestrating application and service migrations to Kubernetes across AWS EKS and on‑prem environments—driving performance, security, and resilience. Partnering closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Software Engineering teams, you’ll architect and automate deployments end‑to‑end, lead initiatives that expand our container orchestration, modernize CI/CD pipelines, and standardize provisioning with infrastructure‑as‑code. If you thrive on building scalable platforms that ship faster and safer, this is the role. Key Responsibilities: Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters across AWS EKS and on‑premises environments. Lead migration efforts from AWS ECS to EKS and on‑prem Kubernetes platforms. Develop and maintain Terraform modules for infrastructure provisioning and configuration. Implement, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI. Apply security best practices for containerized applications and Kubernetes cluster configurations. Collaborate with development teams to define standardized application deployment workflows. Monitor system performance and reliability, troubleshoot, and resolve complex infrastructure issues. Contribute to the creation of operational documentation and automate routine tasks to minimize manual intervention. Knowledge & Skills Required: Extensive hands‑on experience with Kubernetes administration and full cluster lifecycle management. Proficiency in Terraform for implementing Infrastructure as Code. Strong background in CI/CD pipeline design and Git‑based workflows. Deep understanding of Docker and containerized application architectures. Solid grasp of networking fundamentals, including DNS, routing, load balancing, ingress. Familiarity with observability tools and stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and Open Telemetry. Ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems and deployment environments effectively. English – Intermediate level – capacity to keep oral conversation with native speakers. Required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar role. Proven expertise in managing Kubernetes clusters on a scale, both in cloud and on‑premises environments. Hands‑on experience implementing Infrastructure‑as‑Code using Terraform. Supervisory Responsibilities: This position has no supervisory responsibilities. Position Type and Expected Hours of Work: This is a full‑time position. As a full‑time position, the DevOps Engineer is eligible to participate in benefits coverage offered to Katalyst employees based on geographical location. Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional extended hours to support deployments or maintain service continuity Hybrid work model – three remote days and two on‑site days per week. Travel: Minimal travel may be required for on‑premises infrastructure support, implementation, or occasional team collaboration. If participation in an offsite meeting is requested, all related travel expenses will be covered or reimbursed, in accordance with the company’s policies and local regulations. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences. Track record of delivering results in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. Nice to Have: Experience with backend technologies, especially those integrated with mobile applications. Familiarity with distributed systems and large-scale app architecture. Contributions to internal SDKs, libraries, or mobile design systems. Understanding of user authentication, session management, and app state handling. Leadership in global teams. Why Join Us Impact at Scale: Help shape the mobile experience for millions of customers across multiple countries, with the goal of reaching billions. Technical Leadership: Influence the architecture and foundational technologies that all Nubank engineers rely on. Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade. Responsabilidades e atribuições Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é sua chance. Nessa posição de Product Manager , você vai somar ao time de Monetização que tem como objetivo escalar as vendas de produtos pagos para clientes profissionais na OLX . No dia a dia você vai: Liderar o Ciclo Completo (Upstream e Downstream): Garantir que a estratégia se transforme em entrega real, planejando, executando e acompanhando desde o Discovery até o deploy final, garantindo que o que foi planejado seja entregue com excelência. Atuar em Trio de Produto (Engenharia, Design e Produto): Trabalhar em estreita parceria com Engenharia para viabilidade técnica, Design para uma experiência centrada no usuário e Marketing de Produto (PMM) para garantir que o valor das novas funcionalidades seja comunicado corretamente ao mercado. Decidir com Base em Dados: Analisar diariamente métricas de funil e comportamento para gerar hipóteses e priorizar o que realmente move o ponteiro de vendas. Executar com Agilidade: Implementar desde validações rápidas até testes A/B para validar premissas rapidamente, garantindo que o aprendizado venha antes do desenvolvimento em escala. Mapear e Mitigar Riscos: Identificar preventivamente riscos de valor, viabilidade, usabilidade e negócio, garantindo que o time não encontre surpresas no meio do caminho. Gerir o Roadmap e Stakeholders: Equilibrar as expectativas de diferentes áreas de negócio com a visão de produto, mantendo um roadmap transparente e focado em valor. Refinar e Comunicar com Precisão: Escrever histórias de usuário detalhadas, gerir o backlog com priorização clara e manter stakeholders informados sobre o progresso, as vitórias e os aprendizados de cada ciclo. Garantir a Qualidade da Entrega: Fazer validações constantes ("está no ar?", "está funcionando como deveria?"), garantindo que a experiência do usuário seja impecável após o lançamento. Buscar o Impacto para o Negócio: garantir que as entregas estão alcançando o impacto desejado para o negócio, pivotando caso necessário. Requisitos e qualificações E o que você precisa ter? Experiência como Product Manager: Vivência prévia na gestão de produtos digitais, preferencialmente em contextos B2B. Foco em Growth e Otimização de Funil: Experiência prática na gestão do funil de conversão, identificando gargalos e oportunidades para alavancar métricas de aquisição, ativação e retenção através de um processo contínuo de experimentação e escala. Ownership de Ponta a Ponta: Responsabilidade sobre o ciclo completo do produto (Upstream e Downstream), garantindo qualidade desde o refinamento até a validação em produção. Organização e Capacidade de Gestão de Backlog: Capacidade de estruturar rotinas e manter o planejamento de entregas alinhado, garantindo previsibilidade para o time. Autonomia em Dados: Habilidade para coletar, interpretar dados e transformá-los em insights acionáveis. Você deve ter domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados para extrair indicadores e validar hipóteses de forma independente. Comunicação Assertiva e Colaboração: Habilidade de conectar Engenharia, Design e Stakeholders, garantindo transparência e alinhamento em todas as etapas. Resiliência em Cenários Ambíguos: Conforto para atuar em ambientes de rápida mudança, transformando incertezas em planos de ação claros. Visão de Negócio e Estratégia: Entendimento de como o produto se encaixa nos objetivos macro da empresa e no mercado, garantindo que o roadmap esteja alinhado à sustentabilidade financeira e competitividade do negócio. Curiosidade e Visão de Mercado: Busca constante por benchmarks e entendimento profundo do comportamento do usuário para propor melhorias contínuas na jornada. Informações adicionais Mais sobre o Grupo OLX: No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real. title: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience
description: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large). As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross‑functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable. This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel. If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high‑performing teams, you should join our team. Key job responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a team of Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes specialists, fostering a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement Own the end‑to‑end pricing strategy for logistics partners across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, ensuring competitive and sustainable rate structures Design, implement, and optimize incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness Oversee the payment lifecycle — from invoice validation and payment accuracy to dispute identification, root‑cause analysis, and resolution Build and maintain scalable mechanisms for pricing governance, incentive tracking, payment reconciliation, and dispute management Develop structured reporting and dashboards to monitor pricing competitiveness, incentive ROI, payment accuracy, and dispute aging/resolution rates Partner cross‑functionally with Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to align pricing models with business objectives and contractual frameworks Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention in payment and dispute processes Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to ensure Amazon's partner economics remain competitive Manage escalations related to partner payments and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder alignment Define and track KPIs for the team, establishing clear goals, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports A day in the life Your day starts with metrics review and the team's priorities. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross‑functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data‑driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross‑functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale. About the team The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP, AMXL, and AMPL programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well‑designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross‑functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering Speak, write, and read fluent in English Experience managing and developing high‑performance teams Experience conducting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translating results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations Experience working with cross‑functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc. Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English Experience in deal management and pricing strategy, or financial consulting Preferred Qualifications MBA, or Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field Experience using SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques Experience in logistics Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field Experience designing incentive programs or performance‑based compensation structures Experience building payment reconciliation or dispute management mechanisms at scale Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Fleet Services Manager
description: Fleet Services Manager Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. The Position The Fleet Service Manager will oversee the efficient and effective operation of the Tournament fleet and any ancillary event. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of fleet services and operations, working close to the other Transport workstreams providing a reliable, on-time and outstanding service for the established FIFA Client Groups, such as PMAs, Referees, VVIP, FIFA Delegates, FIFA Workforce and Arrivals and Departures. The Fleet Services and Operations Manager will play a crucial role in optimizing fleet performance, developing and ensuring compliance of Service Level Agreements, Policies and Procedures, Operational Plan and Reports. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA/LFS departments for all fleet-related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event. Act as the primary operational interface between FIFA Transport and the VIK vehicle provider (Hyundai/Kia), ensuring full alignment on vehicle specifications, delivery timelines, service levels, and operational needs. Coordinate the reception, inspection, and acceptance of VIK vehicles, ensuring all units meet quality and operational readiness criteria before deployment. Manage the return, decommissioning, and handback process of VIK vehicles post-tournament, including damage reporting, documentation, and reconciliation with the provider. Act as the primary operational interface with Vehicle and drivers’ suppliers ensuring service has been delivered as per contract. Monitor Fleet services performance against agreed KPIs, escalating issues and implementing corrective actions when service levels are not met. Manage all ancillary contracts and operational processes related to the fleet, including vehicle washing and cleaning, refueling services, toll management, and the handling of traffic fines. Develop the fleet depot Concept of Operations (including the fleet design) and ensure its implementation across all Host Cities. Coordinate with all Host Cities depot locations, space, utilities, and facility requirements to confirm requirements are fully met. Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to all Fleet Operations. Act as the central coordinator for the development of Fleet Policies & Procedures, reports, presentations and Guidelines. Manage day-to-day operations pre and during event and subordinate staff including supervisors, coordinators, dispatchers, depot planners, administrative assistants and drivers. Do the entire setup of the Fleet Tournament Management System (TMM). Ensures all fleet staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of FIFA-required modules (e.g TMM, fleet management system), operational workshops and briefings, safety guidelines, and role-specific instructions. The manager maintains consistent training standards across all Host Cities. Its also responsible, in coordination with the fleet service providers, for developing and delivering the full training program for all drivers and fleet operational team, including designing training content, defining formats (classroom, online, practical sessions), and establishing clear timelines and schedules. This includes planning how and when training will be delivered across all Host Cities, determining training duration and required number of days, organizing group sessions to cover the entire driver workforce, and ensuring consistent standards and materials. During tournament ensure all job requests are correctly entered, validated, and assigned with the appropriate vehicle and driver. Oversee dispatching procedures, monitor vehicles while in operation, and ensure real-time coordination with Host Cities for seamless service delivery. Particular attention should be given to VVIP vehicles and all arrival and departure transfers, ensuring precise planning, communication, and execution in alignment with other Host City transport teams. Provide regular reporting to the Transport Senior Manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with other event areas (Security, FIFA Travel, Guest Operations, TSV, etc.) to ensure coherent and efficient engagement with fleet service matters. Your Profile Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset. Minimum of six (6) years of event transport and fleet services experience in international major events in at least three (3) world-class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management. Minimum of three (3) years of management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project. Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale. Proven experience of managing fleet services and operations projects of a similar size and scale. Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced and high-volume environment. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Communications Technician
description: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the‑art Satellite fleet consists of 14 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat‑1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit Reporting to the Manager, Satellite Operations, the Communications Technician performs real time Telemetry, Track and Control (TTC) of all satellites operated by Telesat Brazil and monitors ground systems according to established procedures and policies; is responsible for all aspects of successful in‑orbit mission operations; serves as an interface to internal and external customers, as it relates to the daily transponder accesses; and is responsible for the overall ground station or facilities operations. Responsibilities Satellite In-Orbit Operations Monitor all in-orbit satellite performance. Provide routine operations to maintain the satellite orbit and subsystems health. Provide emergency system operations in accordance with contingency plans; Respond immediately to all anomalous events and/or alarms; Prepare anomaly reports to engineers for further investigation; Operate, configure and monitor satellite subsystems, including: Power, Thermal, Reaction Control, Attitude, TT&C, and Communications; Perform station keeping maneuvers, battery reconditioning, eclipse operations, and other routine operations; Maintain and operate ground station TT&C equipment: Antenna Control Units, Command, Ranging and Telemetry racks, and Command Encryption modules; Maintain and operate front-end processors and associated computers; Conduct special satellite testing as directed by satellite engineering/management. Customer Service Operations Answer incoming calls from Uplinkers, Customers, and persons requesting information. Perform Uplinker performance checks and transponder-access tests, including Transponder frequency, Polarization, Deviation, and Power. Correlate power/polarization level adjustments with field technicians. Monitor consoles, maintain event logs, and enter information into databases. Perform troubleshooting of reported video and audio troubles using appropriate test equipment. Identify and elevate service outages and abnormal conditions. Assist other technicians during busy times and provide relief during breaks and lunch periods. Respond to all customer trouble calls and inquiries - initiate, review, update, and clear trouble tickets. Coordinate customer booking problems and transponder service extensions with Telesat Engineering. Perform satellite and transponder restorations as directed by the restoration plans. Assist Engineering and customer Field Engineers as requested. Perform in-service 'Console Transponder Calibration' tests using supplied hardware/software. Setup consoles and monitor audio teleconferencing bridges for satellite news feeds. Perform calibration tests on spectrum analyzers and other equipment used in the Service Assurance Center (SAC). Coordinate customer additions and disconnects as directed by scheduled Service Orders. Coordinate satellite transponder change requests as directed by Engineering. Isolate and resolve satellite transponder interferences. Perform certification tests for all new digital uplinkers. Ground Station/Facilities Operations Operate, configure and monitor ground station subsystems, including: Electric, Air Conditioning, Communications, IT; Maintain and operate ground station equipment: Antennas, RF, IF, Communications, test equipment; Record all significant customer activities or internal events in the station log; Maintain and update facility site documentation; Perform preventive and corrective maintenance; Prepare Performance Analysis reports, as requested by engineering/management; Develop, maintain and distribute daily reports, operational shift logs and trouble ticket database to appropriate individuals on a needed basis; Prepare and distribute (E-mail) daily reports; File completed logs; Perform shipping, ordering, handling, inventory, and testing of on‑line and spare parts; Monitor building, fire, and security systems. Handle on-call, special and In-Charge assignments Education and Experience required Technical specialization (Certified Technician) on Telecommunications or Electronics. Ability to write, read and speak on both English and Portuguese languages. Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals; Ability to write routine reports and correspondence; Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization. Decision making and Supervision: Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action; Receives instructions on new assignments or projects; Actively seeks information and guidance to improve own performance. title: Especialista em Arquitetura Soluções | Infra e Telecom - Arquitetura de Tecnologia
description: Descrição da vaga Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay. Desafios estratégicos: O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário. Atuação de Arquitetura: A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. O que a área te oferece de oportunidade: Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa Diversidade: Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (RJ ou SP) Responsabilidades e atribuições Como será seu dia a dia: Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de Infraestrutura e Telecom, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia tecnológica e de negócio da companhia; Construir e manter modelos arquiteturais, mapas de capacidades, princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos para orientar decisões executivas e estruturantes de I&T; Produzir desenhos arquiteturais de alto nível conectando domínios, plataformas e capacidades tecnológicas; Atuar de forma crítica e consultiva junto às áreas técnicas, questionando soluções, identificando lacunas e propondo direcionamentos estruturantes; Avaliar impactos arquiteturais de novas iniciativas, tecnologias e decisões estratégicas; Incorporar o conceito de AI-First Architecture nas decisões e modelos arquiteturais, promovendo automação, inteligência operacional e uso estratégico de dados; Comunicar e apresentar conceitos arquiteturais para públicos técnicos e executivos. Ponto de atenção: Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo. Requisitos e qualificações Do que você precisa: Formação superior em carreiras de tecnologia, como engenharias, ciência da computação, etc; Pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura, Tecnologia, Telecom, Cloud ou áreas afins. Inglês Avançado/Nativo para leitura, escrita e comunicação; Experiência como arquiteto corporativo, arquiteto de domínio ou arquiteto de soluções; Experiência em ambientes tecnológicos complexos, distribuídos, híbridos ou multicloud; Vivência em Infraestrutura, Telecomunicações ou ambos, com capacidade de sustentar decisões arquiteturais nesses domínios; Experiência na definição de arquiteturas e direcionamentos técnicos em contextos de transformação tecnológica ou organizacional; Experiência em modelagem de capacidades (Capability Mapping) e construção de modelos arquiteturais; Capacidade de definir princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos; Domínio em infraestrutura on-premises, cloud ou ambientes híbridos; Entendimento de resiliência, disponibilidade, escalabilidade, automação e observabilidade em plataformas tecnológicas; Expertise em arquitetura de redes, conectividade e serviços de telecom; Entendimento conceitual de IA e suas relações com infraestrutura e telecom. description: Role Overview Magnet Forensics, a leader in digital forensics solutions, is seeking a dynamic Director of Sales to lead a team of Account Managers covering the LATAM region. The Director will actively engage in the region to identify, progress, and close strategic opportunities while fostering a high-performance team culture. Collaborating cross-functionally across the Company, the Director will ensure alignment to achieve revenue goals. The ideal candidate is a proven sales leader with exceptional coaching, presentation, and selling skills. Focus on team performance, learning and development opportunities to enhance sales capabilities. Manage and grow channel program in region, ensuring quota, linearity, and market penetration across region. Grow multi‑product customer accounts, increase average deal size, acquire new logos, and displace competitive solutions. Actively participate in the territory to identify, progress, and close strategic opportunities, with a focus on selling higher within accounts. Deliver accurate weekly sales forecasts and ad‑hoc updates to ensure predictability and alignment with revenue goals. Cross‑Functional Collaboration Partner closely with other internal stakeholder teams (Renewals, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Rev Ops etc.) to drive cohesive strategies that support revenue attainment. Leverage insights from cross‑functional teams to refine sales approaches and enhance customer engagement. Operational Excellence Utilize available resources and tools to manage sales processes, track performance, and optimize team productivity. Travel will be required approximately 50%+ of the time to engage with customers, support the team, and attend strategic meetings or events. Ensure the team adheres to best practices in pipeline management, opportunity progression, and customer relationship development. What We’re Looking For 7+ years of sales leadership experience, preferably in law enforcement software sales or technology solutions, with a track record of consistently exceeding revenue targets. Proven experience managing, coaching and developing a team of Account Managers. Strong background in selling to public safety, law enforcement, or government sectors in the LATAM market; familiarity with digital forensics or cybersecurity solutions is a plus. Demonstrated success in executing go‑to‑market strategies, growing multi‑product accounts, increasing deal sizes, and displacing competitors. Exceptional presentation, coaching, and consultative selling skills, with the ability to engage senior‑level stakeholders. Proficiency in Salesforce, Microsoft 365, Clari, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and SalesLoft for sales forecasting, pipeline growth, and process optimization. Strong analytical skills to produce accurate forecasts and interpret sales performance metrics. Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross‑functional teams. Strategic thinker with a hands‑on approach to driving deals and supporting the team in the field. High‑energy leader with a passion for building a culture of accountability and success. Proficiency in speaking English, Portuguese, and Spanish. Willingness to travel approximately 50 – 75% of the time across the LATAM region. Construção de Relacionamento: Desenvolver relações de confiança com os hotéis e receptivos da sua carteira, entendendo profundamente seus negócios, desafios e objetivos. Gestão de Pipeline: Trabalhar a carteira com disciplina de CRM (Hubspot), mantendo oportunidades mapeadas, status atualizado e follow-ups no prazo. Representação no Trade Local: Participar de visitas, feiras regionais e eventos do setor, representando a Decolar e identificando novas oportunidades de negócio. Interface com Parceiros: Traduzir atualizações de produto, pricing e distribuição em ganhos concretos para os hotéis. Para se candidatar, você precisa ter: Experiência: 3 a 5 anos em travel (hotelaria, operadoras, receptivos, OTAs) ou em vendas/account management B2B consultivo em ambientes dinâmicos. Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Turismo, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Perfil Consultivo: Escuta ativa, postura estratégica e capacidade de ganhar confiança pela substância das recomendações. Habilidade com Dados: Excel avançado, leitura fluente de dashboards (Metabase, Power BI) e curiosidade para entender os números em profundidade. Comunicação: Clareza na comunicação, escuta ativa e habilidade para conduzir conversas comerciais do zero. Perfil de Owner: Proatividade, iniciativa e capacidade de fechar ciclos de trabalho sem necessidade de instruções constantes. Ferramentas: Experiência com CRM (Hubspot), Google Workspace e ferramentas de análise de dados. Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes na região do RJ e Costa Verde. É importante que tenha CNH ativa Idiomas: Português nativo; inglês intermediário; espanhol é um diferencial. Paixão por Travel: Interesse genuíno pelo setor de hospitalidade online e turismo. Diferenciais Conhecimento da dinâmica do mercado local (RJ e Costa Verde). Local de Trabalho Base no Rio de Janeiro, com visitas frequentes aos parceiros na região. title: Manager, Ceremonies
description: Department: Events & Entertainment Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Manager supports the end to end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, the Ceremonies Manager supports the planning and operational delivery of all official ceremonies, working closely with the Senior Manager and wider Entertainment team to ensure alignment with FIFA’s vision, brand standards. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring that all ceremonies are executed in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment Team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Manager supports the Senior Manager in coordinating the operational delivery of ceremonies, contributing to creative and operational review processes and helping ensure the execution of iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Support the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Support the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through pre-production, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into match day and event day operations. Escalate ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Support the Ceremonies Team by contributing to day-to-day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards. Assist with the onboarding and support of Ceremonies personnel—suppliers, freelancers, and event-time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness. Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing. Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Contribute to coordination between venue-based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonies workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Support the planning and delivery processes for all major ceremonial events, including Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament. Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Support the development and refinement of the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony in collaboration with the Entertainment Team. Contribute to the integration of host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful manner. Assist in the creation of creative briefs, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows in coordination with internal teams and external agencies. Contribute to stakeholder approval processes to ensure all content is delivered, documented, and archived in line with operational requirements. Support IP and copyright compliance across all ceremony-related content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Coordinate with multiple suppliers and conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Support the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and provide operational support on event days. Support operational decision-making to help maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Assist with rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Support venue level preproduction activities, including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Support procurement processes as directed by the Ceremonies Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation. Manage day-to-day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s). Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-up. Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalute risks to the Senior Manager as needed. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as a liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE, in coordination with the Senior Manager. Deliver concise briefings and alignment updates across all internal and external stakeholders. Support the building and maintenance of relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Support preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and support execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Assist in rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre-event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by management aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and management briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. Experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments. FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem-solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross-functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus. The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Especialista de Arquitetura de Dados e IA - Arquitetura de Tecnologia
description: Descrição da vaga Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital.
